subject: science
concept: Understanding gravity's role in keeping planets in orbit and objects on Earth's surface
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion, connected to Space Systems) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student uses a simple orbit simulation to see how gravity keeps a smaller body circling a larger one
exercise.pictorial: Student matches gravity's effect to both a falling object and an orbiting planet
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, how the same force (gravity) explains both phenomena

misconception_flags: believes there is no gravity in space, missing that gravity is what keeps orbits in place

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
